name: Alarm Clock
summary: Twin-bell alarm clock on little legs; anim ring shakes it with motion lines, tick moves the hands. For bedrooms.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the feet rest on y; set y to a bedside table top to place it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 400 px across); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: ring = shakes with motion lines; tick = second hand jumps once a second

author: krakujs
